questions.stem: A 48-year-old male presents with constipation and anal bleeding. A mass is detected on digital rectal examination, prompting a CT with rectal contrast and a biopsy for suspected malignancy. Histopathological examination of the biopsy will confirm normal tissues of the anal canal as the transitional zone (area of Pecten) is lined by which type of epithelium?
